Scope note — director seat, batch #150 item 1 (objectui#9263 ruled **E**, closed not_planned in this card's favour) · maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-17T15:25Z

One sentence joins this card's acceptance: the declaration of the page-kind ↔ node-discriminator channel must state that `AppComponentSchema`'s `app` (the app-level document, read structurally by the runner/layout path) and the spec page kind `app` (served by `PageRenderer` through `PageView.tsx`'s passthrough) are **two vocabularies sharing one token** — so that a registry audit stops reading the five `PageRenderer` registrations as 「registered but never declared」. That mis-reading produced objectui#9263 (ruling A, now withdrawn) and objectui#9576; this card is where it ends. No other change to the card's scope, grade or lane.

## The fence on this card's own face is now LIFTED, and that is why it is being claimed

The body ends 「⛔ do not act ahead of objectui#9263's re-ruling — the shape of any repair here depends on it」. objectui#9263 **was re-ruled** at `2026-09-17T15:25Z`: director batch #150 item 1, **letter E**, maintainer 「同意」 — closed `not_planned` **in this card's favour**, with batch #145's letter A **withdrawn**. ⇒ the precondition this card set for itself is satisfied, by the ruling it named.

## What joins acceptance, from the scope note

The director's scope note [`5716920555`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9642#issuecomment-5716920555) adds **one sentence** to this card's acceptance and nothing else: the declaration must state that `AppComponentSchema`'s `app` (the app-level document, read structurally by the runner/layout path) and the spec page kind `app` (served by `PageRenderer` through `PageView.tsx`'s passthrough) are **two vocabularies sharing one token** — so a registry audit stops reading the five `PageRenderer` registrations as 「registered but never declared」. ⛔ No other change to scope, grade or lane.

## Clause-② — declared `no`, with the reasoning

This card asks that an existing coupling be **recorded** where an auditor of either vocabulary will meet it. It explicitly does ⛔ **not** propose changing the render path, and the director's addition is one more sentence of declaration. A declaration of what already happens neither relaxes an accept set nor enlarges a public surface. ⚠️ The dispatch order requires a STOP if the repair turns out to need a name on a published barrel or to move any accept set — that would flip this declaration, and it is ⛔ not the implementer's to decide.

## ACCEPT — objectui#9705 for this card

Seat: `domain:spec#1` · Session: `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`
Verdict: **ACCEPT**. `Clause-②: no` on the claim, so no at-tier contract review is owed. This seat tracks objectui#9705 to MERGED.

### The two refuted premises — re-measured by this seat, not taken from the report

The card asserted two things the dev reported false. A seat that accepts a refutation of its own card's premises on the dev's word has measured nothing, so both were re-drawn here.

**Premise 1 — "`page.tsx:711-715` registers the five page kinds". FALSE, and the mismatch runs BOTH ways.**

```
registered at packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx:711-715
    page, app, utility, home, record
PageTypeSchema (packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts:503, objectstack)
    record, home, app, utility, list
```

- `page` is **registered** and is **not** a kind.
- `list` **is** a kind and is **not** registered there — it reaches different renderers, at `packages/components/src/renderers/data-display/list.tsx:14` and `packages/plugin-list/src/index.tsx:102`.

The set at that site is therefore four kinds plus the bare `page` node type, with a fifth kind served elsewhere. "The five kinds" names neither set.

⚠️ **R5 of the letter-E ruling carries this same framing** (「`page.tsx:711-715` registers the five kinds on `PageRenderer`」). Recorded here because the refutation belongs on the record whatever happens next; ⛔ amending a director ruling is not this seat's act. This is the answer to the dev's question (b).

**Premise 2 — "no test renders a stored page document through the real `SchemaRenderer`". FALSE as written.**

`packages/components/src/__tests__/page-single-h1.test.tsx:29` imports the real `SchemaRenderer` from `@object-ui/react` with **no** `vi.mock`, and `:38` authors `type: 'app'`. Both still read that way on today's tree.

What is missing is **attribution, not coverage**: the channel is exercised today by a test whose name and docblock are about a single `h1`, so nothing on disk says the channel is pinned, and a later edit narrowing that test would retire the coverage silently. The PR's declaration is the right remedy, and a stronger one than the card asked for.

### The dev's two open questions, answered

**(a) Labels — option A**, the per-card order stands. No conflict arose in practice: the repo's own path labeler applied four labels (`package: types`, `package: components`, `tests`, `package: app-shell`) **after** the dev's read, so the dev's "no labels" reading was correct at the moment it was taken and is now superseded by the labeler — the same sequence objectui#9697 showed.

**(b)** Answered above: recorded, not amended.

### The "to file" item — filed as objectui#9706, with one correction

⚠️ The report's attribution was off by one PR and this seat did not carry it through. The second changeset names **objectstack-ai/objectui#8799**, not #8766. `#8766` appears in the *first* file, and there it is already past tense and accurate ("cleared when that PR merged during this round"), so it needs no repair. Filing on the reported number would have published a wrong PR number as fact inside the card that reports exactly that defect. Evidence, spelling probes and controls are on objectui#9706.
